section.sectionSummaryBrief: Through Israel fulfilling God's request to reveal the level of Mah of the soul in two ways, God fulfills Israel's request for dwelling in His house and grants each a good and sweet year.
section.t: And through the fact that Israel fulfill the request of the Holy One, blessed be He, to reveal the Mah of the soul in the two aforementioned manners — the revelation of the Mah itself as it is above form,
and its revelation as it is drawn into actuality in the particular levels of the soul
— through this the Holy One, blessed be He, will fulfill the request of Israel,
both the general and essential request, "One thing I have asked"45
as it is in itself — "that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life,"
and also as it is drawn into many particulars
("to behold the pleasantness of the Lord and to visit His Temple," etc.),
and the Holy One, blessed be He, gives each and every one of Israel a good writing and sealing46
for a good and sweet year in materiality and spirituality, below ten handbreadths.
